        PowerSimulationsDynamics.configure_logging — Method
        configure_logging(; console_level, file_level, filename) -> InfrastructureSystems.MultiLogger

        configure_logging(;
    console_level = Logging.Error,
    file_level = Logging.Info,
    filename = "power-simulations.log",
)

        Creates console and file loggers.

        Note: Log messages may not be written to the file until flush() or close() is called on the returned logger.

        Arguments

        • console_level = Logging.Error: level for console messages
        • file_level = Logging.Info: level for file messages
        • filename::String = power-simulations.log: log file

        Example

        logger = configure_logging(console_level = Logging.Info)
@info "log message"
close(logger)
        source

        PowerSimulationsDynamics.kirchoff_laws! — Method
        kirchoff_laws!(sys::Any, V_r::Any, V_i::Any, I_injections_r::Any, I_injections_i::Any, dx::Any)

        Kirchoff law for buses.
I_gen_r[j]: Real current injection from all generators connected at bus j.
            It is zero if no generator is connected at bus j.
I_gen_i[j]: Real current injection from all generators connected at bus j.
            It is zero if no generator is connected at bus j.
